title: ecbolium nanum
intro: Ecbolium nanum, commonly known as False Plectranthus, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium nanum include its ability to act as an antiseptic, an anti-inflammatory, and a bronchodilator, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
